	title = dtp_ed_title
	desc = dtp_ed_desc
	picture = GFX_evt_dtp_access
	is_triggered_only = yes
	diplomatic = yes
	custom_gui = "dtp_ed_win_5"
	option = {
		name = dtp_edopt_1
		custom_gui = "dtp_edopt_1"
		custom_tooltip = dtp_edopt_1_tt
		hidden_effect = {
			set_country_flag = dtp_ed_open
			set_variable = { which = dtp_edtab value = 1 }
			set_variable = { which = dtp_edcat value = 1 }
			set_variable = { which = dtp_edpg value = 1 }
			from = {
				dtp_vsync = yes
			}
			country_event = { id = dtp.1995 scopes = { from = this } }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = dtp_edopt_2

		custom_tooltip = dtp_edopt_11_tt
		hidden_effect = {

			from = {
				dxxohrp = yes
				dxgtkrc = yes
				dxdo31j = yes
			}
			dtp_load = yes
			dtp_esl_fill = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { exists = event_target:dtp_lv }
					exists = event_target:dtp_t
				}
				event_target:dtp_t = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							exists = ruler
						}
						ruler = {
							save_global_event_target_as = dtp_lv
						}
					}
				}
			}
			from = {
				dtp_vsync = yes
			}
			country_event = { id = dtp.1995 scopes = { from = this } }
		}
	}

country_event = {
	id = dtp.1996
	hide_window = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { which = dtp_petab value = 1 }
			}
			country_event = { id = dtp.1981 scopes = { from = this } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { which = dtp_petab value = 2 }
			}
			country_event = { id = dtp.1982 scopes = { from = this } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { which = dtp_petab value = 3 }
			}
			country_event = { id = dtp.1983 scopes = { from = this } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { which = dtp_petab value = 4 }
			}
			country_event = { id = dtp.1984 scopes = { from = this } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { which = dtp_petab value = 5 }
			}
			country_event = { id = dtp.1985 scopes = { from = this } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { which = dtp_petab value = 6 }
			}
			country_event = { id = dtp.1986 scopes = { from = this } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { which = dtp_petab value = 7 }
			}
			country_event = { id = dtp.1987 scopes = { from = this } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { which = dtp_petab value = 8 }
			}
			country_event = { id = dtp.1988 scopes = { from = this } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { which = dtp_petab value = 9 }
			}
			country_event = { id = dtp.1989 scopes = { from = this } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { which = dtp_petab value = 10 }
			}
			country_event = { id = dtp.1990 scopes = { from = this } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { which = dtp_petab value = 11 }
			}
			country_event = { id = dtp.1991 scopes = { from = this } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { which = dtp_petab value = 12 }
			}
			country_event = { id = dtp.1992 scopes = { from = this } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { which = dtp_petab value = 13 }
			}
			country_event = { id = dtp.1993 scopes = { from = this } }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { which = dtp_petab value = 1 }
			set_variable = { which = dtp_pecat value = 1 }
			set_variable = { which = dtp_pepg value = 1 }
			country_event = { id = dtp.1981 scopes = { from = this } }
		}
	}
}
